# PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk (BBYB.JK)

Auto-dossier, 2026-11-11. Fundamentals only — no prices, valuation multiples, analyst targets or estimates (two-phase protocol, consensus quarantine). Source: company financial statements via Yahoo Finance (annual + quarterly tables). Verify load-bearing lines against the filing before citing.

sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown:
Financial Services / Banks - Regional · Indonesia. PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk provides digital banking products and services in Indonesia. The company offers individual banking services, including personal and business accounts; regular, NOW, Neo wish, and Neo business savings; WOW and FLEXI time deposits; Neo and micro business loans; transaction services, such as transfer, hematpay, QRIS, virtual accounts, bills and top up, and cardless cash withdrawal services; Neo membership; and gamified experience comprising Neo world, SocialFi, and…

Note: bank-format statements (no gross profit line) — use the VAL_BANKS card's NII/credit-cost lens; margins below are of total revenue.
